specification.input_notes: The only file in the listed deposit is PipelineOlympics-main.zip (Zenodo 16573651), which contains the CWL workflow implementations and analysis R scripts, i.e. the original implementation, not the analysis inputs. The raw sequencing data are deposited in the European Genome-Phenome Archive under accession EGAS50000000541 (S0202), which is not part of the listed deposit. The gold-standard consensus corridors derive from the BLUEPRINT Consortium study (ref 23) and the Illumina HumanMethylation450 array data (S0073-S0074), also not in the listing. No data files are therefore available among the listed files.

leakage_files.name: PipelineOlympics-main.zip
leakage_files.reason: Contains the CWL versions of all evaluated workflows with containerization details and all analysis R scripts (S0202-S0203), i.e. the original implementation that computes the target ranking; serving it would leak the method and derived results.

specification.comparison_metric: Rank average of the 10 workflows across all five protocols and six metrics (coverage AUC, genome-wide deviation, gold-standard locus deviation, DM calling, run time, max memory), compared to the reported ordering in Fig. 8A/Supplementary Table S5.
specification.numerical_agreement_criterion: Performance metrics on the identical split: the workflow ordering and rank averages must match the reported ranking; counts exact; scalars within displayed rounding bin.
specification.specification_gaps: The exact rank-average values are not printed in the main text (only in Supplementary Table S5, not available); the tie-breaking z-score procedure is described but its numeric inputs are not given; the exact per-metric rank values are only in figures/supplement.
